text:
Leah Morgan: Quick check-in: Customer Z wants 7-year audit retention for some regulated tenants. They need searchable access for e-discovery. Product needs a minimal, contractable MVP and launch criteria.
Devon Park: Can you confirm whether they need instant search or can accept delayed reindexing? That drives infra cost.
Leah Morgan: They said near-interactive for legal reviews is preferred, but they'd tolerate up to 72h for court-ordered requests. Ops asked for an SLA window.
Ravi Shah: From Legal: if we promise extended searchable retention, requirements: contractual clause, proof-of-integrity for archives (signed manifest + hashes), and an access audit trail for who performed retrievals.
Devon Park: Ops/infra notes: keeping full inverted indexes for 7y multiplies storage and ES maintenance. Cheaper pattern: keep raw event blobs + lightweight metadata (event id, timestamp, event-type) indexed. Full-text reindex on demand.
Leah Morgan: Proposed MVP shape:
- Default searchable retention = 1 year.
- Extended retention offered as paid contract addendum (enterprise only).
- Archive pipeline produces per-tenant signed manifest + SHA256 checksum per chunk.
- If tenant BYOK enabled, archives encrypted with tenant key; otherwise platform key.
- Reindex-on-demand available with SLA 48-72h; reindex compute billed to customer unless pre-bought credits.
- Export and retrieval operations logged to audit trail with user/principal and timestamp.
Ravi Shah: Legal: add "hash algorithm and UTC timestamp" fields to manifest, plus manifest signature algorithm version. Also require explicit customer acknowledgement of reindex cost in contract.
Devon Park: Implementation details: store objects at: audit/tenant=<id>/archive/YYYY/MM/chunk-<uuid>.ndjson.gz. Include companion manifest: manifest-<version>.json.sig. Add object metadata header: x-archive-policy: extended.
Leah Morgan: Edgecases: what if tenant rotates BYOK and revokes access? We need a policy: either require escrow of a recovery key (customer consent + contract), or we refuse reindex if key not available. Legal prefers escrow + contractual exception.
Ravi Shah: We'll draft escrow language but limit to contracted enterprise pilots. Also require customer to attest key retention for archival retrieval periods.
Devon Park: Ops: reindex-on-demand flow will need template job config. Minimal prototype: lambda to fetch chunks, decrypt with KMS/tenant key, stream into reindexer. Need to add throttles and a queue for concurrency control.
Leah Morgan: Acceptance checklist for launch pilot:
- Contract addendum template for extended retention + key-escrow clause
- Archival export pipeline producing signed manifests + checksums
- BYOK encryption integrated for archives
- Retrieval runbook with 48-72h SLA and billing code
- Audit logging for retrieval triggers and who accessed data
- Pilot limited to explicit enterprise customers only
ops-bot: RFC created: RFC-ER-2023-09. Link PRs to RFC.
Devon Park: Action items:
- Devon: build small PoC to produce manifest and test BYOK encrypted archive
- Leah: coordinate pilot contract with Customer Z and legal
- Ravi: draft contract language and escrow template
- ops-bot: assign ops for runbook and cost estimate
Leah Morgan: Let's circle Friday 09:30 PT to review POC and the draft addendum. Add blockers below. :thumbsup:
Ravi Shah: Noted blocker: key-escrow process needs legal approval and security review.
Devon Park: Blocker: need an ETA on KMS BYOK APIs from infra (pinging infra team separately).
Leah Morgan: Thanks team — I'll send calendar invite and pilot invite to Customer Z after the contract draft.
